title: Integrate API Docs into Global Navigation and Sourced Header Metadata

navigation.apiDocs: Desktop and mobile nav contains link to '/api-docs' with exact label 'API DOCS'.
navigation.activeRoute: Active route state is determined via isActive(currentPathname, href); active link carries aria-current="page" and prominent active telemetry styling (border-pitwall-accent text-white font-bold on desktop; bg-pitwall-accent/15 border-pitwall-accent/30 on mobile). Inactive links carry aria-current=undefined.
navigation.ariaBehavior: Desktop navigation has aria-label="Desktop Navigation". Mobile navigation has aria-label="Mobile Navigation" and id="mobile-nav". Hamburger toggle button has aria-label="Toggle navigation menu", aria-expanded binding, and aria-controls="mobile-nav".

sessionDerivedMetadata.status: Reflects real useRaceSocket state (LIVE, REPLAY, STALE, OFFLINE). When socket.connected is true, status is guaranteed non-OFFLINE (defaults to REPLAY if speed is present, else LIVE). Displays configured speed badge only for REPLAY mode (e.g. '• 20x').
sessionDerivedMetadata.lapCount: Sourced lap count displays current lap (or '-' when null/zero) and total laps. Total laps is dynamically resolved from active socket.totalLaps or resolveCircuitTotalLaps(socket.sessionId) against verified calendar and replay references (Monza: 53, Spa: 44, Monaco: 78, Silverstone: 52). When total laps is unavailable or offline, concisely renders 'N/A' and never hardcodes 66.
sessionDerivedMetadata.ariaStatusLabels: Status badge carries accessible role="status" with aria-label="Session status: <STATUS>". Lap badge carries role="status" with aria-label="Lap <X> of <Y>" or "Lap <X>, total laps unavailable". Flag badge carries role="status" with aria-label="Track flag: <FLAG>".
sessionDerivedMetadata.noPlaceholders: Zero useNow polling hooks, zero synthetic standby/next grand prix placeholders, zero fake connection badges ('WS CONNECTED'), zero 'on track' / 'off track' mock flags, and zero em-dashes (— or –).

scenarios: Scenario 1: Static source audit: nonBlankNonCommentLines <= 250 (237 pure LOC), zero em-dash / en-dash characters, no totalLaps = 66 or ?? 66, no fake 'WS CONNECTED' / 'STANDBY' / 'NEXT:' placeholders.
Scenario 2: Navigation items contract: NAV contains /api-docs with label 'API DOCS'; all 7 expected navigation routes matched in exact order.
Scenario 3: isActive helper properly matches exact root '/', route matches, subroutes ('/drivers/44' matches '/drivers'), and rejects prefix substrings ('/drivers-overview').
Scenario 4: Render tests: pathname='/api-docs' renders desktop nav with aria-current='page' and 'API DOCS'; inactive links do not have aria-current='page'.

Scenario 5: Mobile navigation: default initialMobileOpen=false renders hamburger button with aria-expanded='false' and omits mobile-nav container; initialMobileOpen=true renders aria-expanded='true' and mobile-nav with aria-label='Mobile Navigation' and all 7 links.
Scenario 6: Connection and provenance statuses: verifies rendering and accessible aria-label for 'LIVE', 'REPLAY', 'STALE', and 'OFFLINE'.
Scenario 7: Replay speed badge renders '• 20x' when status='REPLAY' and speed='20x'; live status omits speed multiplier.

Scenario 8: Dynamic total lap count: Monza renders 53 (not 66) with aria-label='Lap 12 of 53'; Spa renders 44 with aria-label='Lap 5 of 44'; unavailable renders 'N/A' (not 66) with aria-label='Lap -, total laps unavailable'.

Scenario 9: resolveCircuitTotalLaps resolves '2024_monza' to 53, 'spa_replay' to 44, 'silverstone_2025' to 52, 'monaco' to 78, and safely returns null for null, undefined, or unknown fictional tracks.
Scenario 10: Track flag indicators: renders 'SAFETY CAR' and 'Track flag: SAFETY CAR' for SC flag; renders 'RED FLAG' and 'Track flag: RED FLAG' for RED flag.
Scenario 11: Zero-prop default rendering: renders status 'OFFLINE', total laps 'N/A', zero 66 defaults, and full navigation with 'API DOCS'.
